title: processed_wtisen
description: Normalized WTISEN test-result records used for Delta upsert in the curated zone.

fields.name: barcode
fields.description: Barcode identifier for the submitted water sample.

fields.name: date_collected
fields.description: Date and time when the sample was collected.

fields.name: date_received
fields.description: Date and time when the laboratory received the sample.

fields.name: date_released
fields.description: Date and time when the laboratory released the result.

fields.name: date_reported
fields.description: Date and time when the result was reported.

fields.name: laboratory
fields.description: Laboratory processing site name or identifier.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary contact phone number associated with the submission.

fields.name: alt_phone
fields.description: Alternate contact phone number associated with the submission.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: First name of the person associated with the sample.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Last name of the person associated with the sample.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Street address associated with the sample submission.

fields.name: lot_num
fields.description: Lot number provided in the submission details.

fields.name: concession
fields.description: Concession information provided for the sample location.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City name associated with the sample location.

fields.name: municipality
fields.description: Municipality associated with the sample location.

fields.name: county
fields.description: County associated with the sample location.

fields.name: emergency_loc_no
fields.description: Emergency location number captured in the WTISEN record.

fields.name: postal
fields.description: Normalized postal code associated with the sample location.

fields.name: entry
fields.description: Numeric WTISEN entry identifier.

fields.name: formatted_entry
fields.description: Formatted WTISEN entry identifier as supplied in the report.

fields.name: total_coliform
fields.description: Reported total coliform test result value.

fields.name: e_coli
fields.description: Reported E. coli test result value.

fields.name: req_legible
fields.description: Indicates whether the requisition text was legible.
